classification.all_map: road + atv + flying; total across these vehicle types, not civilian-only.
classification.atv: On-map, living vehicles whose VehicleType is ATV.
classification.civilian: On-map vehicles excluding player owner, alien owner, and ORG_MEGAPOL.
classification.event_counters: Counters of transitions visible between endpoint samples. Entries, building arrivals, deaths and retirements can omit complete trips or vehicles that appear and disappear within a frame.
classification.flying: On-map, living vehicles whose VehicleType is Flying.
classification.max_road_stopped_ticks: Maximum current mission roadStoppedTicks among on-map ground vehicles at the checkpoint; absent in intermediate observer, so its CSV cells are blank.
classification.parked: Living vehicles in the current city with currentBuilding set, including player vehicles.
classification.police: All on-map vehicles owned by ORG_MEGAPOL, including generated ambient vehicles.
classification.road: On-map, living vehicles whose VehicleType is Road.
classification.road_stopped_12000: Number of on-map ground vehicles whose current mission roadStoppedTicks is at least 12000 at a checkpoint; counts waiting independently of endpoint displacement.
classification.stationary_12000: Active mission-bearing ground vehicles with no net observed position displacement across one or more five-minute frames; threshold is 12000 ticks but sampling is 43200 ticks.

confirmed_long_wait.confirmation_basis: Final actual roadBlocker diagnostics are reciprocal; mission roadStoppedTicks corroborates a long wait independently of endpoint stationary metric.

input.resume_semantics: Loaded preserved startup save and initState; no startGame, reseeding, mission resets or vehicle deletion by observer.

intermediate_dataset_preservation.reconstruction: First 724 rows restricted to original_columns reproduce the original LF CSV bytes; missing new stopped-counter fields are blank, not zero.

limitations: These are individual runs, not independent replicated estimates or a test of statistical significance.
Identical initial save and RNG state did not produce bit-for-bit identical six-hour/day prefixes; each trace is retained separately.
Population is sampled after each five-minute updateTurbo frame, not continuously within the frame.
stationary_12000 is an endpoint displacement measure and cannot establish continuous immobility by itself.
Endpoint event counters omit sub-frame trips; do not treat them as total dispatch throughput or total completed journeys.

The intermediate observer invoked updateTurbo directly through canTurbo gameplay eligibility. Its candidate six-hour receipt logs one canTurbo=false error. Those intermediate receipts are not proof of uninterrupted valid UI Speed 5 during hostile activity.

Increased density does not demonstrate healthy flow. The intermediate post-review day final diagnostics confirm two reciprocal blockers with roadStoppedTicks exceeding 11.6 million ticks; the later final candidate is reported separately.
The baseline here already contains the earlier ambient spawning/lane fixes; it is pre-review 0ea2a77b, not the earlier bce8974 baseline used in the separate Speed 4 dataset.
The four pre-review and intermediate receipts precede the adjacent-junction correction. They are retained as individual observations and must not be presented as acceptance of the final candidate.

Final six-hour and day runs use turbo-unchecked. Six-hour run saw zero unavailable frames; day saw two. The separate final one-hour run strictly checked turbo eligibility and saw zero unavailable frames.

Final day maximum sampled roadStoppedTicks is 359706 ticks; 37 checkpoints have at least one mission road wait over 12000 ticks. These episodes recovered by the final checkpoint; do not claim all queues or waits were eliminated.

Final coarse six-hour receipt ends with one endpoint-stationary diagnostic, but its final maximum current-mission stopped counter is 1 tick. Endpoint displacement and road waiting are distinct measures.
New stopped-counter fields were not collected in intermediate runs. Blank CSV values mean unavailable, not zero.

method.dispatch_counts: Count of Traffic batch at messages in log.txt, independent of map-entry sampling.
method.means: Unweighted arithmetic mean over equally spaced population checkpoints in each specified window.
method.observer_evolution: Intermediate mode=turbo invoked updateTurbo without an eligibility check. Final mode=turbo checks canTurbo before every frame; final mode=turbo-unchecked counts unavailable frames and proceeds explicitly.
method.sampling: Initial checkpoint then one census after each completed five-minute frame.

receipt_root_description: Local receipt directory /tmp/openapoc-traffic-observed; all artifact paths below are relative to this directory.
